title: Add S3-compatible storage adapter

context.summary: Implement real S3-compatible object storage for LibreFS/external S3 profiles.
context.background: The installer plan requires storage choices beyond local-fs. The existing @mindory/storage-s3 package is still a skeleton, and API/worker runtimes currently reject storage.provider=s3.

in: Support path-style endpoints for local S3-compatible services such as LibreFS/MinIO.
Use AWS Signature V4 signing without introducing a new SDK dependency.
Wire API and worker runtime storage factory to use S3ObjectStorage when MINDORY_STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3.
Add a local S3-compatible smoke test to storage validation.
Update docs to remove the S3 skeleton warning.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/storage-s3 performs network put/get/stat/exists/delete operations against an S3-compatible endpoint.
The adapter validates object keys and maps 404s to object_not_found.
API and worker runtimes can construct S3ObjectStorage from Mindory config.
A local S3-compatible smoke test covers put/get/stat/exists/delete.
Storage validator no longer expects storage_not_implemented.
No database schema changes are included.
risks: S3-compatible services vary in strictness; the adapter should use conservative path-style SigV4 requests.
The smoke test should not require downloading external Docker images.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
